name: Estival-Gibber
description: Sand owns this world, in colors from bone-white to burnt sienna, migrating with the seasons before a patient wind. Where the gusts strip it away, a tidally locked hemisphere emerge like the bones of the planet.

In the calm seasons the world feels almost kind, which veterans say is exactly when it takes the careless. Carpet-flora blooms all at once after each rare rain, turning whole basins scarlet overnight.
Something about this world resists explanation. Every expedition answers three questions and returns with five better ones.
Mining charters include clauses about 'subsurface events' that lawyers refuse to define.
